description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.menuassets.

assetArray.description: The ordered Parts.Menu values stored at MessagePack Key(1).
assetArray.title: Menu asset array
assetArray.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve array order and edit each menu's identity, category, and command references coherently.
assetArray.x-meido-game-usage: PartsMenuManager registers each menu, derives lookup IDs, and later executes its command list.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: MenuAssets, MaterialAssets, and PriorityMaterialAssets share the indexed fields Key(0) fileName and Key(1) assetArray; name lookup removes the extension, lower-cases the name, and hashes it.
The menu manager merges asset arrays, derives IDs from lower-case file names, and resolves menu commands and category metadata at runtime.

fieldCount.title: Container field count
fieldCount.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it when editing existing data.
fieldCount.x-meido-game-usage: It controls compatibility with future container fields but is not a menu gameplay value.

fileName.description: The container name stored at MessagePack Key(0).
fileName.title: Asset-container file name
fileName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep the expected .menuassets name and preserve the source case when round-tripping.
fileName.x-meido-game-usage: The manager uses it as the source identity while merging menu assets.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: MenuAssets, MaterialAssets, and PriorityMaterialAssets share the indexed fields Key(0) fileName and Key(1) assetArray; name lookup removes the extension, lower-cases the name, and hashes it.
The menu manager merges asset arrays, derives IDs from lower-case file names, and resolves menu commands and category metadata at runtime.

futureSlots.description: Raw MessagePack values beyond the known container keys.
futureSlots.title: Container future slots
futureSlots.x-meido-game-usage: Current KCES does not interpret these slots.

nilSlots.description: Per-slot nil markers retained by the lossless codec.
nilSlots.title: Container nil-slot metadata
nilSlots.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it together with assetArray nil elements.
nilSlots.x-meido-game-usage: Nil-versus-empty state affects MessagePack shape rather than menu semantics.

nullElements.description: Positions of null elements in the asset array.
nullElements.title: Null asset elements
nullElements.x-meido-edit-guidance: Do not compact the array unless every dependent index is intentionally rewritten.
nullElements.x-meido-game-usage: The manager may skip null entries while preserving array positions.

nullMapValueKeys.description: Raw null-map metadata from indexed nested objects.
nullMapValueKeys.title: Null map values
nullMapValueKeys.x-meido-game-usage: The game serializer distinguishes null map values from absent keys.

rootNil.description: Whether the entire asset container root was nil.
rootNil.title: MessagePack nil root
rootNil.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep rootNil and assetArray state consistent.
rootNil.x-meido-game-usage: A nil root represents an absent asset container rather than an empty menu list.

trailingData.description: Bytes after the first MessagePack root value.
trailingData.title: Asset-container trailing bytes
trailingData.x-meido-game-usage: The manager does not consume this region.
